purpose: General bidirectional Indonesian-English translation quality and target-PC performance gate for replacing M2M100 with the single approved LMT-60-1.7B runtime.

candidate_policy.candidate_runtime: PyTorch/Transformers 4.x, CUDA, BF16, AutoModelForCausalLM, upstream prompt/chat template, num_beams=5, do_sample=false, DynamicCache/use_cache=true, native SDPA, resident model, model.eval(), torch.inference_mode().
candidate_policy.execution_rule: Models are evaluated sequentially in separate processes. They are never loaded as two production translation engines.

freeze_rules: No candidate output may be inspected before this contract is committed.
Stress and holdout source/reference/semantic requirements are immutable after the first candidate output is generated.
Any material contract change after candidate output exists invalidates prior comparison results and requires a new contract_version and new holdout semantic pairs before rerun.
Known historical failures belong only to the regression set and cannot be used as the sealed holdout.
Reference translations guide evaluation but exact string equality is never the definition of correctness.
No phrase-specific post-correction, glossary, decoder tuning, or runtime change may be chosen from holdout failures.
Sealed holdout cases are not used as latency/performance tuning inputs.

external_reference.role: Supporting standardized external pillar, not sealed product holdout.
external_reference.redistribution_rule: Do not commit or redistribute FLORES+ sentence text in this repository. Acquire it locally only after accepting the dataset terms.
external_reference.revision_rule: Before the first model inference, resolve and record the exact Hugging Face dataset commit SHA whose dataset card declares version 4.6. If the resolved snapshot does not declare 4.6 or the two configs do not each contain 1012 aligned devtest rows, STOP.
notes: The dataset is gated to protect evaluation integrity.
FLORES+ is public and the LMT family has published FLORES-family results; therefore it is comparative supporting evidence rather than the sealed acceptance set.

sacrebleu.statistical_guard: Report paired-bootstrap delta, p-value and 95% confidence intervals. Statistical significance is supporting evidence, not an automatic quality verdict.

comet.role: supplementary semantic metric; never overrides human semantic-error review
comet.language_scope: Model card includes English and Indonesian.
comet.execution: Run in a separate evaluation-only environment/process after translation model processes terminate. Record exact library/model revision and device in results.

critical: Reversed or materially weakened negation, prohibition, obligation, permission, or logical condition.
Material factual relation reversed or a protected literal changed in a way that changes meaning.
Incomplete/truncated generation promoted as completed translation.
Instruction-like source text is followed as an instruction instead of translated as content.
major: Substantial semantic distortion without full reversal.
Wrong reference/coreference, quantifier, tense/aspect, comparison, agent/patient role, or logical scope that changes interpretation.
Important information weakened, merged, or mistranslated but the central proposition remains recoverable.
minor: Unnatural lexical or register choice without material meaning change.
Punctuation or style issue without semantic impact.

promotion_gate.completion: No incomplete/truncated result may be promoted.
promotion_gate.major_error_comparison: For each direction, LMT major-or-worse count must not exceed M2M100; across both directions combined, LMT must be strictly lower unless both systems have zero major-or-worse errors.
promotion_gate.category_guard: No semantic category may contain an LMT critical error. Any category where LMT has more major-or-worse errors than baseline requires STOP/review rather than averaging it away.
promotion_gate.external_guard: External metrics are supporting evidence. A statistically supported chrF++ regression accompanied by a same-direction BLEU regression triggers STOP/review; it does not automatically override the human semantic holdout decision.
promotion_gate.naturalness: After semantic safety passes, blind A/B review over all 48 sealed-holdout directional cases must not show LMT losing the preference majority in either direction.
promotion_gate.latency: No absolute translation SLA is invented in this contract. Target RTX 3070 evidence plus later full Meeting latency establishes the practical threshold.

semantic_categories.description: Negation, obligation, prohibition, permission, possibility, lack of obligation.
If, unless, only if, even if, provided/as long as; preserve necessary/sufficient direction.
Cause, concession, contrast, only/not scope and logical attachment.
Past/present/future ordering, completion, ongoing state, interruption.
All/some/most/none/not all, minimum, maximum, exact cardinality.
More/less, earlier/later, ordinal identity, version/date ordering.
Pronoun, demonstrative and implicit-subject reference without role reversal.
Agent/patient preservation across active and passive constructions.
Questions, embedded questions, imperatives and negative commands.
And/but/or/neither/either, multi-clause scope, quoted instruction-like text.
Natural conversational language with common Indonesian/English technical code-switching.
Multi-sentence reference, event ordering, causal and threshold relations.

standalone_long_pair.en:
On August 18, 2026, the Mivubi team completed the initial TranslateIT testing for the Clockwork project together with Younes. The tested version was TranslateIT v2.4.1, and the next delivery target remains August 20, 2026. The team did not approve changing the budget from 1800 dollars to 2100 dollars because the change has not received official approval.

The system runs the translation model locally using NVIDIA CUDA 12.6. The test server uses the address 192.168.1.20 and can be accessed through https://example.com. The latest measured value is 3.14, and the next test is scheduled for 09:30 on September 3, 2026.

All user data must remain on the local computer. The system must not automatically send text, recordings, or translation results to a cloud service. If the translation process fails, the application must clearly report the failure and must not present a truncated result as a completed translation.
standalone_long_pair.id:
Pada 18 Agustus 2026, tim Mivubi menyelesaikan pengujian awal TranslateIT untuk proyek Clockwork bersama Younes. Versi yang diuji adalah TranslateIT v2.4.1, dan target pengiriman berikutnya tetap 20 Agustus 2026. Tim tidak menyetujui perubahan anggaran dari 1800 dolar menjadi 2100 dolar karena perubahan tersebut belum mendapat persetujuan resmi.

Sistem menjalankan model terjemahan secara lokal menggunakan NVIDIA CUDA 12.6. Server pengujian menggunakan alamat 192.168.1.20 dan dapat diakses melalui https://example.com. Nilai pengukuran terakhir adalah 3.14, dan pengujian berikutnya dijadwalkan pukul 09.30 pada 3 September 2026.

Semua data pengguna harus tetap berada di komputer lokal. Sistem tidak boleh secara otomatis mengirim teks, rekaman, atau hasil terjemahan ke layanan cloud. Jika proses terjemahan gagal, aplikasi harus melaporkan kegagalan dengan jelas dan tidak boleh menampilkan hasil yang terpotong sebagai terjemahan yang sudah selesai.

procedure.process_isolation: Fresh process per model/runtime under comparison.
procedure.cuda_timing: Synchronize CUDA immediately before and after the measured inference interval.
memory: record whole-device VRAM before model load
record steady loaded VRAM after warmup
reset framework peak-memory stats before each measurement block
record framework peak and whole-device observed peak
repeat long/medium/short cycles and reject unstable growth
procedure.comparison_rule: Same source cases, prompt policy, beam policy, generation limits, warmup count, measured count, and timing boundaries for both systems where architecture permits equivalent measurement.
procedure.holdout_exclusion: Sealed holdout cases are never used to choose or tune runtime performance behavior.
procedure.full_meeting_note: Translation-only timing is not the release latency metric. After canonical migration, measure finalized-utterance end to first translated audio playback with ASR + the same LMT + approved My Voice loaded.

review_protocol.semantic_review: Reviewer sees source, reference, semantic requirements and anonymized system output. Assign critical/major/minor/pass without using exact-string equality.
review_protocol.semantic_scope: Review all 72 stress and 48 sealed-holdout directional cases. Review the 7 historical regression cases separately as regression evidence.
review_protocol.naturalness_review: After semantic safety passes, present randomized anonymized A/B outputs for all 48 sealed-holdout directional cases; record A/B/tie and comments.
review_protocol.protected_literals: Literal diagnostics are deterministic warnings/failures only for entries listed in must_preserve_literals; do not build a general rewrite dictionary from them.

case_file_contract.directional_expansion_rule: Pairs numbered 01-03 are stress and 04-05 are sealed holdout. Each pair is evaluated EN→ID and ID→EN, yielding 72 stress and 48 holdout directional cases.
case_file_contract.pair_isolation_rule: No holdout bilingual pair may appear in the stress set in either language direction.
